    Hancock Park & Larchmont (90004) home sales fell 26.5% vs last year

    Hancock Park & Larchmont (90004) · October 2026

    In Hancock Park and Larchmont, 90004, homes sold are down 26.5% from last year, so buyers should compare budgets carefully with recent completed sale prices.

    Median sale prices

    Median sale prices are now $1.28M, down 26.3% from a year ago and down 10% from five years ago. Buyers comparing budgets should use the latest completed sales as their reference point.

    Price per square foot

    Price per square foot is $759, down 7.3% from a year ago. Buyers comparing homes of similar size and condition should look closely at what those homes actually sold for.

    Available homes

    There are 165 homes available, up 1.9% from a year ago and up 12.2% from five years ago. Buyers have a slightly wider selection to choose from.

    Median days on market

    The median days on market is 60, down 11.8% from a year ago. Sellers can plan a marketing timeline around that figure, though it is not a promised sale date.

    Homes sold

    Homes sold total 36 in the 3 months ending October, down 26.5% from a year ago. Sellers should weigh these completed transactions when reviewing their asking price.

    Sales above, at and below asking

    Most homes sold below asking, more common than last year.

    Local happenings

    Charles White Park Reimagined in Altadena

    Los Angeles County broke ground October 3 on a reimagined Charles White Park in Altadena. Plans bring together an inclusive playground designed by Disney Imagineers, a splash pad, lighted pickleball courts, and a new recreation center. Native shade trees, accessible walkways, a demonstration garden, and public art will give visitors more ways to play, gather, and explore the five-acre park. If you live in 90004, this gives you a future county outing to look forward to, with play areas, gardens, and recreation in Altadena.

    Sale-to-list percentage

    Homes are selling for about 3% under their final asking price. Sellers can review completed comparable sales before choosing an asking price.
